title: Asphalt 3D
shortDescription: Asphalt 3D helps define a Nintendo 3DS family racing path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Keeps a documented racing option visible in the Nintendo 3DS family collection.
Separates the GameAtlas catalog method from the external factual reference.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Documented for the Nintendo 3DS family racing discovery path using the documented Wikidata platform mapping; this remains a catalog-method note with no imported numerical signal.
